apps.description: Off-grid Android chat and gaming client for the MeshCore LoRa mesh network
apps.releaseNotes:
# Meshi v1.101

Off-grid Android chat and gaming for the MeshCore LoRa mesh network. Connects to a MeshCore node over Bluetooth LE — no internet, no cellular, no infrastructure.

## Downloads

| APK | Signing | Notes |
|-----|---------|-------|
| **app-release.apk** | Release key, R8-minified (~2.5 MB) | Recommended for general use |
| **app-debug.apk** | Debug key (~17 MB) | For troubleshooting; includes debug symbols |

> The two APKs are signed with different keys and share the same application ID. To switch between them on one device, uninstall the existing install first.

Install: enable "install from unknown sources" on your device, then open the APK.

## What's new in 1.101

This release focuses on reliability and release hardening.

### Reliability
- **Automatic send retry** with exponential backoff for transient BLE failures
- **Thread-safe** delivery-confirmation and typing-indicator tracking
- **Input validation** on all data received from the mesh (names, messages, GPS, channels) to guard against malformed packets
- **Advert expiry** — stale node advertisements time out after 30 minutes

### Architecture
- Frame-routing logic extracted into a dedicated `FrameRouter`
- Game-invite and SOS-beacon handling extracted into focused managers
- Centralised tunable constants in `MeshiConfig`

### Release hardening
- R8 code + resource shrinking for release builds (~85% smaller APK)
- On-device-only storage: cloud backup and device-to-device transfer disabled for messages, contacts, and location
- Unit test suite for game logic, input validation, and retry behaviour

## Requirements
- Android 5.0 (API 21) or newer
- A MeshCore-compatible LoRa node reachable over Bluetooth LE

## License
GNU General Public License v3.0 — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# Clint Browser v1.2.6

## What's New

### MEGA Downloads

You can now download straight from MEGA links!

- Open a MEGA file or folder link and Clint offers to download it for you.
- Folder links open a picker where you can select all, keep the folder structure, skip files you already added, and download on Wi‑Fi only.
- MEGA downloads can be paused, resumed, and split into multiple parts like any other download.
- Files are decrypted on your device while they download. The key in the link never leaves your phone.
- Clint gets a fresh download link from MEGA every time a download starts or retries, so old links don't break your downloads.
- Quota limits and broken links now show a clear message instead of a vague error.
- Don't want it? Turn off **Detect MEGA links** in Settings › Downloads.

---

### Download Manager

#### Add Without Starting

New **Add** button in the bottom left of every download dialog. It puts the download in your list paused so you can start it later.

- It works for links, streams and Media Capture, blobs, MEGA files and folders, redownloads, and manual downloads.
- It skips the mobile data and battery prompts, since nothing is downloading yet.
- It's turned off while you have a scheduled start set.
- Paused blob downloads are kept safe in app storage, so they survive a restart.

(Thanks to @anonymous-shanks for suggesting this [#32](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/32))

#### Refreshing Links

- Each download now remembers the page it came from, separately from the Referer header. Refreshing a link takes you back to the right page instead of just the site's home page or the video player's site. The Properties dialog shows both.
- While you're refreshing a link, picking a video in Media Capture offers to update the paused download right away.
- Updating a link now sends the same User-Agent, Referer, and cookies as the download, skips the check when the link didn't change, ignores error pages, and tells you when a link opens a web page instead of a file.

(Thanks to @DarkHorse313 for reporting this [#16](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/16))

#### Download History

New **Save download history** and **Save Incognito download history** switches in Settings › Downloads. Turn one off and finished downloads from that mode won't stay in your Downloads list. The file and the completion notification stay either way. Unfinished, paused, and failed downloads are always kept so you can resume or retry them.

(Thanks to @anonymous-shanks for suggesting this [#32](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/32))

#### Duplicate File Handling

New **Duplicate file handling** setting in Settings › Downloads.

- **Always ask** lets you choose what to do each time.
- **Add a duplicate** keeps both files and adds a number to the new one.
- **Overwrite existing file** replaces the old file.

The automatic options only kick in when the existing download is already finished.

#### Other Download Changes

- The Downloads library remembers whether you used grid or list view.

(Thanks to @anonymous-shanks for suggesting this [#32](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/32))

---

### Media Capture

#### Better Detection

Media Capture now finds streams on a lot more sites.

- It catches playlists served without a file extension or with an unusual file type.
- It recognizes DASH manifests by their content.
- It no longer misses media that loads before a tab is fully set up, or media loaded by a service worker.
- It skips links it already listed.
- It keeps your results when a page only changes the part after `#` in its address.

(Thanks to @Ahmedal2022 for the patch that started this [#36](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/36))

#### YouTube

YouTube protects its videos in a way Media Capture can't save.

- If YTDLnis is installed, opening Media Capture on YouTube sends the page straight to YTDLnis.
- If it isn't, Media Capture explains why YouTube can't be captured and shows a **Get Y

apps.description: Android keyboard that learns your words on your device: personal suggestions and prediction, dictation, clipboard, emoji and translation. Finnish and English.
apps.releaseNotes:
Suggestions arrive earlier. Suomeksi alla.

- **Every learned word competes from the first letter:** the candidate pool no longer cuts long, less frequent words before scoring
- **Longer words gain from the letters they save**, while short common words such as "ja", "on" and "se" stay first
- **Inflected forms strengthen each other:** "sovellus", "sovelluksen" and "sovelluksessa" share one family, so a rarer form rises after a few uses
- **A word typed only once gets no own-word bonus:** a typo no longer sits on the row for dozens of ignores
- **Ignored suggestions sink in proportion to their use** and return as soon as you type the word again
- **Sentence starts are learned:** after a full stop, a question mark or in an empty field, your usual opening words are offered
- Measured on the owner's own vocabulary (8 000 learned words) as the row is shown: with a learned word pair the right word is among the first three suggestions after 2.0 letters instead of 2.2, and by the second letter in 74 % of cases instead of 67 %; without a learned pair after 3.8 letters instead of 4.1

---

Ehdotukset tulevat aiemmin.

- **Jokainen opittu sana kilpailee ensimmäisestä kirjaimesta:** ehdokaskori ei enää karsi pitkiä, harvemmin käytettyjä sanoja ennen pisteytystä
- **Pitkät sanat saavat etua säästetyistä kirjaimista**, mutta lyhyet yleissanat kuten "ja", "on" ja "se" pysyvät ykkösenä
- **Taivutusmuodot vahvistavat toisiaan:** "sovellus", "sovelluksen" ja "sovelluksessa" ovat samaa perhettä, joten harvinaisempi muoto nousee jo muutaman käytön jälkeen
- **Kerran kirjoitettu sana ei saa oman sanan bonusta:** kirjoitusvirhe ei enää jää riville kymmenien ohitusten ajaksi
- **Ohitetut ehdotukset painuvat suhteessa käyttöön** ja palaavat heti, kun sanan kirjoittaa uudestaan
- **Lauseen alku opitaan:** pisteen tai kysymysmerkin jälkeen ja tyhjään kenttään tarjotaan omat aloitussanasi
- Mitattu omistajan omalla sanastolla (8 000 opittua sanaa) rivin näkyvästä listasta: opitulla sanaparilla oikea sana on kolmen ensimmäisen ehdotuksen joukossa 2,0 kirjaimella entisen 2,2 sijaan ja toisella kirjaimella 74 %:ssa tapauksista entisen 67 %:n sijaan; ilman opittua paria 3,8 kirjaimella entisen 4,1 sijaan

With hide when locked (Android's own setting on Android 16 and later, the launcher's on Android 15) a locked space has no tab and is opened through the search. Nothing about private apps is stored or backed up, and their notifications are not read. (#25)

Improved
- A screen reader says a work app's profile with its name ("Mail, Work") wherever its icon is.
- The start-up profile is recorded again over this release.

Fixed
- Back in the Settings search puts the keyboard away first and keeps what was typed; the next Back returns to the category list (Android 16 and later).

Updating keeps your layout and settings. One new permission, granted without a prompt: ACCESS_HIDDEN_PROFILES, which lets the default launcher see Android's private space. SHA-256 of ARK-launcher-1.1.0.apk: 74630e1555a4aeded36d9738eb29e1b47ad05bf6db1a74968e414e87949b97a6

apps.description: Free, encrypted internet calls between friends, inside a complete replacement for your phone's Phone and Messages apps. Android, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3; no ads, no tracking.
apps.releaseNotes:
## What's fixed

**A hidden number is announced as an unknown caller.** Some networks attach a placeholder name such as "Anonymous" or "Unknown" to a call from a restricted number, and the app read it out as the caller's name. A call whose number may not be shown now keeps no name: the announcement says "Unknown caller is calling" in your language, and the call screen and notification show "Unknown number".

**One call, one entry in the call log.** When an ARK call reaches the other phone but cannot connect and goes over the carrier instead, the receiving phone used to log both the ARK attempt and the carrier call, and raise a missed-call notification for a call that was still ringing. The ARK entry now waits twenty seconds and is dropped when the same caller rings over the carrier. A missed call that arrives while the app is open is marked seen rather than announced.

Update from 1.28 in place; the APK carries the same signature and your data is kept. Requires Android 8.0 or newer.

apps.description: Android app store for open-source apps on GitHub. Developers publish an app by adding the topic "arkstore" to its repository; the store installs and updates APKs straight from GitHub releases.
apps.releaseNotes:
An app can now be shared as a link, and its earlier versions are a tap away.

- **Share** in an app's details gives out a link to the app. On a phone with ARK-Store the link opens the app's page in the store; anywhere else it opens a page of the store's new site, [arkstore.jrs8205.com](https://arkstore.jrs8205.com), that tells where the app and the store are found
- **Earlier versions** in an app's details: up to three versions before the newest one, for apps from GitHub, Codeberg and GitLab. With root on, the version you choose is installed in place of the one installed. Without root its file is saved in Download/ARK-Store; when the installed version is newer, the app has to be uninstalled first, as Android does not install an older version over a newer one
- **After going back with root**, the update to the newest version stays on offer, but the background check no longer installs it by itself: it is installed when you ask for it
- The button that opens an app's page names the place the page is on, GitHub, Codeberg or GitLab, or says that it opens the project's page
- A link to an app the lists do not have says so, on whichever page is open

Without root the store downloads `ARK-Store-1.13.0.apk` into Download/ARK-Store and you install it from the Files app; with root on it installs the update itself. If Play Protect blocks it, please cancel and report the app version and your device. Don't turn protection off or choose Install anyway.

apps.description: Android device monitor with a home-screen widget, per-app usage insights and a charging screensaver. Fully offline - no internet permission. GPL-3.0-or-later.
apps.releaseNotes:
## What's changed

- **Six screensaver styles.** Settings → *Screensaver* now starts with a row of styles, each thumbnail drawn by the screensaver itself: *Glow* (the look so far, and still the default), *Minimal*, *Ring*, *Gauges*, *Night* and *Edge*. Every style works upright, on its side and flipped upside down.
- **Edge** draws the battery level as a bright line round the screen's edge, from red to green with the level. Its head pulses while the battery charges, and at 100 % the line closes into a loop. Against burn-in the line changes place once a minute and dims after ten minutes without a change.
- **Night** shows the clock, the next alarm and the battery in dim red on black, and can come on by itself for the night-dim hours.
- **Gauges** shows monospaced figures on named rows and, if you switch it on, the next three calendar events. The calendar permission is asked for only then; nothing is stored, and the titles can be hidden.
- **What the screensaver shows** is yours to choose: switches for the device name, seconds, date, next alarm, notification icons, battery details and time to full, and five accent colours for the seconds.
- **Own brightness.** A slider sets the screensaver's brightness for every style instead of following the phone's. The settings page shows the level while you move the slider. It is not in force while the screensaver is dimmed.
- **Flip upside down** moved from the button on the screensaver to Settings, so nothing bright stays in one corner. A screensaver flipped with the old button is still flipped.
- The charging bolt stops pulsing at 100 %, and the battery block follows the charger: a phone held on its charger without filling says *Not charging* instead of *On battery*, and the watts and the estimate show only while the battery fills.

More in the [FAQ](https://github.com/jrs8205/Device-Watch/blob/main/FAQ.md) and the [privacy policy](https://github.com/jrs8205/Device-Watch/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).

## Installing

Updates cleanly over v1.4.x and later. If you are coming from v1.3.1 or older (package `com.example.modernwidget`), uninstall the old app first — it is a different package and will not update.

Android-sovellus: Ilmatieteen laitoksen ja Open-Meteon sääennusteet rinnakkain, Suomen pörssisähkön hinnat ja FMI:n säävaroitukset. Nyt myös sadetutka ja sähkön keskihinnat.

## Uutta versiossa 0.5.0

- **Sadetutka.** FMI:n tutkakuvat Maanmittauslaitoksen taustakartalla: 240, 480 tai 960 km, viimeiset kolme tuntia 15 minuutin välein toistuvana animaationa, jonka nopeuden voi valita. Kartta lähennetään nipistämällä ja palautetaan kaksoisnapautuksella. Paikka on kartalla samassa kohdassa koko Suomessa, ja 960 km:n näkymä painottuu Suomen päälle.
- **Oma arvio sateesta tunniksi eteenpäin.** Uusin tutkakuva siirrettynä viime kuvista lasketun liikkeen verran. Tämä on sovelluksen oma laskelma, ei Ilmatieteen laitoksen ennuste, ja se on merkitty näkymässä selvästi.
- **Keskihinnat.** Sähkö-sivulla edellisen vuoden keskihinta ja kuluvan vuoden kuukausikeskihinnat pörssin tapaan tuntihinnoista laskettuina.
- **Huomisen hinnat vasta julkaisun jälkeen.** Halvin, kallein ja kaavio ilmestyvät vasta, kun huomisen hinnat on julkaistu. Aiemmin niissä näkyi lukuja jo ennen sitä, koska huomisen ensimmäinen tunti tiedetään päivää ennen muuta.
- **Hintakaavio.** Valitun pylvään hinta näkyy pylvään päällä ja kuluvan jakson hinta ilman napautusta.
- **Palaaminen taustalta.** Sijainti tarkistetaan aina, mutta alle 15 minuuttia vanha ennuste ja hintatieto säilyvät, ellei paikka ole vaihtunut yli kilometrin. Tuntirivit eivät enää katoa hetkeksi.
- **Käyttöliittymä.** Päivitä-nappi on poistettu: tiedot päivittyvät avauksella ja vetämällä näkymää alas. Pienet tekstit ovat hieman isompia, Varoitukset on sään vieressä alapalkissa, avoimen välilehden napautus vie sivun alkuun, sijaintipilleri vierii sisällön mukana, Sulje- ja paluunapit ovat selkeämmät ja aurinkoajoilla on otsikot.

## Asennus

- Vaatii Android 13:n tai uudemman (API 33). Kohdealusta Android 17 (API 37).
- Lataa `Saa-Sahko-0.5.0-release.apk` ja asenna. Päivitys aiemman version päälle säilyttää suosikit ja asetukset.
- APK:n SHA-256: `49E2B602139CB6C17C925F56AFFF033BD508FAD239F83AE79EB08421FFE85A8E`
- Allekirjoitusvarmenteen SHA-256: `C7:0B:B7:BE:13:92:07:37:47:8F:A8:1C:DD:82:12:BE:BE:DD:C8:AC:8B:63:26:C7:96:4B:6F:6E:B4:FF:96:5E` (julkinen varmenne liitteenä).
- Paikkahaku ja sadetutkan taustakartta vaativat oman Maanmittauslaitoksen API-avaimen käännösvaiheessa; julkaistussa APK:ssa se on mukana.

## Tietolähteet

Ilmatieteen laitos (CC BY 4.0), Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), Elering (Nord Poolin Suomen hinta-alue) ja Maanmittauslaitos (CC BY 4.0). Lisenssi Apache 2.0.

apps.releaseNotes:
Fixes and finishing touches after the new look. Your data stays as it is when you install this over 1.1.0 or 1.0.0.

## What's new in 1.1.1

- Large font sizes: all three tabs of the add-stop window fit on the screen, and the bottom bar labels stay off the screen edge.
- Screen readers read the names of the add-stop and reorder buttons and announce the notices.
- Search fields have a button that clears the text.
- The map places menu opens at full height, so the heavy vehicle and along-the-route switches are visible at once.
- Adding a place from the Map page during a drive asks first.
- The station card lists each nearby charging point with its connectors and, when the open data has it, its price.
- A letter after the house number no longer makes a separate stop: 5, 5 A and 5 B are the same building.
- Imported address lists are checked by Finnish address rules only. .xls and .ods files can be picked and get a notice to save them as xlsx or csv.
- Money, amounts and kilometres use the same thousands grouping as whole numbers.
- The day view's add button follows the car: fill-up, charge or refill.
- Notices and map places give the same tap feedback as other buttons.
- End drive and the other outlined buttons share one look.

## Requirements

Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer, 64-bit device (arm64-v8a).

## Installation

Download `tyomatka-1.1.1.apk` below, open it on the phone and allow the installation from that source when Android asks. It installs over 1.1.0 or 1.0.0 and keeps your work days, fill-ups, cars and settings. Google Play services are not needed.

## Verifying the APK

